title: Doctrine: size and the bad day
dek: Inner reasoning wing: size starts as a dollar loss budget, and size is set off the worst priced day, worked on the book's own numbers.

claims.text: Proposed book at the October 23, 2026 marks (not booked): five positions, per-play shock losses totalling $268,906 inside a 1R per-play cap, summed hard worst case $780,559 against the $1,000,000 complex cap, worst grid print a loss of $716,700 at a $145-or-higher expiry. The three earners are one short-smile driver and are counted once.
